name: LAVA RING
tagline: SLIDE, CAST, AND SEND YOUR RIVALS INTO THE LAVA
howto: FIVE FREE-FOR-ALL ROUNDS. LAST PEPE STANDING WINS; MOST ROUND WINS TAKES THE RUN.
THE STONE IS SLICK: WASD OR ARROWS ACCELERATE, AND YOU KEEP SLIDING WHEN YOU LET GO. STEER EARLY.
AIM WITH THE CURSOR. Q FIRES FUD BLAST; E, R AND F USE SHOP SPELLS. ON PHONE, DRAG THE STICK AND TAP THE ARENA.
BLASTS SHOVE HARDER WHEN A TARGET IS HURT. THE WATCHER BLOCKS SHOTS; LAVA BURNS 28 HP EACH SECOND AND THE EDGE SHRINKS EVERY 15 SECONDS.
SURVIVE, DEAL DAMAGE AND KNOCK FOES OUT FOR GOLD. BUY OR UPGRADE UP TO THREE SPELLS BETWEEN ROUNDS.
